text:
rachel: Kicking off a small 'lean-admin' sweep next week. Targets: ownerless admin bindings, KMS grants older than 180d, and a staging canary. no prod changes until post-owner ack. thoughts?

omar: +1. scope = human admins + svcaccts only? exclude Dedicated customer principals?

rachel: correct. human + service accounts. we'll skip customer Dedicated unless explicitly ownerless. plan: snapshot -> dry-run in staging -> 10d owner notice -> prune.

lina: tooling notes: for AWS KMS, list grants and filter by CreateDate; for GCP, pull key IAM and consult Cloud Audit logs for grant timestamps. capture timestamps in evidence bundle.

sec-bot: [auto] initial scan: 7 ownerless admin bindings, 4 KMS grants >180d. evidence saved: s3://redwood-audit/lean-admin/4291000000.zip

omar: propose dry-run Tue 08:00 PT in infra-staging. I'll run it and verify no auth regressions. will leave PR open 10d before prune.

rachel: nice. action items:
- rachel: publish ownerproof artifacts + notify inferred owners
- omar: run dry-run + post logs
- lina: add rollback rebind commands to runbook and block prunes within 14d of key rotation

lina: added rebind snippet and logging hook to send removals to #security-alerts.

sec-bot: Runbook updated. Post-prune smoke tests will be auto-triggered and results posted to #security-alerts.

omar: dry-run done, no failures in staging; opened PR to remove one orphan svcacct (svc-legacy-ingest). PR: https://git.redwood.com/org/infra/policy/PR-5678 will wait 10d.

rachel: thanks all. keep snapshots for recert evidence and SOC will validate post-prune.

lina: ack :thumbsup:
